content.text:
Explore the old personal website at /Users/dhruveshpatel/Files/dhruvdcoder.github.io thoroughly.

I need a complete inventory of:
1. Directory structure (especially how pages/content are organized vs theme/layout files)
2. All content pages (about, publications, software, mentorship, blog, talks, teaching, CV, etc.)
3. Navigation / site config (_config.yml, menus)
4. Collections, data files (_data/), includes
5. Blog posts if any
6. Assets (images, PDFs, CV)
7. Any custom layouts or plugins
8. What content exists and a brief summary of each page's purpose

Return:
- A clear tree of the content organization
- List of every user-facing page/route with file path
- Key _config.yml settings (title, collections, permalinks, plugins)
- How pages were organized (e.g. in pages/ folder vs root)
- Notable content that would need migration (publications lists, software projects, bio text, etc.)

Be thorough. Read _config.yml, any navigation files, and skim key markdown pages.
